body:
This is not the same as #5426

**What version are you using?**
2.4.0

**What configuration are you using?**
Extends `eslint-config-rlabs` based on `eslint-config-airbnb`

``` json
{
  "extends": "rlabs/es6",
}
```

**What did you do?**
**_Error 1**_
When there is an unused parameter in the contructor

``` javascript
class Child extends Parent {
  constructor(test) {
    super()
  }
}
```

**_Error 2**_
When there is an undefined symbol in the constructor. Mostly noticeable with live linting while typing.

``` javascript
class Child extends Parent {
  constructor() {
    gibberish
  }
}
```

**What happened?**
**_Error 1**_

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'type' of undefined
    at isRedundantSuperCall (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-useless-constructor.js:59:25)
    at EventEmitter.checkForConstructor (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-useless-constructor.js:79:46)
    at emitOne (events.js:82:20)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:169:7)
    at NodeEventGenerator.enterNode (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/util/node-event-generator.js:42:22)
    at CodePathAnalyzer.enterNode (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/code-path-analysis/code-path-analyzer.js:591:23)
    at CommentEventGenerator.enterNode (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/util/comment-event-generator.js:98:23)
    at Controller.traverser.traverse.enter (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:843:36)
    at Controller.__execute (/REDACTED/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:397:31)
    at Controller.traverse (/REDACTED/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:501:28)
```

**_Error 2**_

```
TypeError: Cannot read property 'type' of undefined
    at isRedundantSuperCall (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-useless-constructor.js:24:38)
    at EventEmitter.checkForConstructor (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/rules/no-useless-constructor.js:79:46)
    at emitOne (events.js:82:20)
    at EventEmitter.emit (events.js:169:7)
    at NodeEventGenerator.enterNode (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/util/node-event-generator.js:42:22)
    at CodePathAnalyzer.enterNode (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/code-path-analysis/code-path-analyzer.js:591:23)
    at CommentEventGenerator.enterNode (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/util/comment-event-generator.js:98:23)
    at Controller.traverser.traverse.enter (/REDACTED/node_modules/eslint/lib/eslint.js:843:36)
    at Controller.__execute (/REDACTED/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:397:31)
    at Controller.traverse (/REDACTED/node_modules/estraverse/estraverse.js:501:28)
```

**What did you expect to happen?**
**_Error 1**_
Not crash.  Receive `no-unused-vars` on the unused paramater

**_Error 2**_
Not crash. Receive `no-undef` on the 'gibberish'
